title: Dashboard Snapshot Editor: Prototype, Stakeholder Synthesis, and Visual Redlines
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and handoff for a Dashboard Snapshot Editor that lets users capture, annotate, and share point-in-time dashboard and rollout states. Scope: thumbnail generation, annotation toolkit (highlights, sticky comments, team-mentions), time-range selector tied to rollout timeline, export/share modal, and cost/privacy masking for sensitive tokenized values.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype demonstrates capture → annotate → share flow with working microinteractions
Design tokens and CSS spec exported and linked in GH PR for Console components
Engineering confirms thumbnail generation approach and KV cache snapshot consistency in spike
QA checklist created covering contrast, keyboard navigation, and screenreader labels
decisions: Use PNG thumbnails + separate JSON metadata payload for snapshots to simplify cross-platform replay (trade-off: storage size vs. portability)
Mask token-level cost details by default; provide an explicit 'reveal' action gated by permissions (PM request)
Reuse existing rollout timeline component as the time-range selector to reduce engineering scope for V1
